common.tagline: Get ready for your hospital appointment
common.prototypeBanner: This is a prototype for research. It is not a real NHS service, and every appointment shown is made up.
common.footerText: Care Appointment Success is a Phase 1 prototype for the Contracts for Innovation Cymru challenge: Reducing Missed Appointments and Improving Access to Planned Care.

home.title: Get ready for your hospital appointment
home.intro: Care Appointment Success helps you confirm your appointment, change it, or get help if something might stop you coming.
youCan: change or cancel your appointment, so someone else can use the time
tell us if something might make it hard to come, and find help
ask for a phone call from someone who can help
home.privacy: This prototype does not collect, store or send any personal information. Nothing you choose here leaves your device.

appointment.title: Your appointment
appointment.place: Outpatients Department, Royal Glamorgan Hospital, Llantrisant
appointment.question: Can you come to this appointment?
appointment.barriers: I might not be able to come
appointment.change: I need to change or cancel it
appointment.help: If something is making it hard to come, tell us. We will not judge you, and it will not affect your care.

confirmed.title: Thank you, your appointment is confirmed
confirmed.body: We will send you a reminder the day before.
bring: a list of any medicines you take
your glasses or hearing aid, if you use them
someone to support you, if you would like
confirmed.changeHint: If anything changes, you can change your appointment at any time.

barriers.title: Is anything making it hard to come?
barriers.hint: Choose all that apply. Your answers help us support you. They will not affect your care.
barriers.legend: Things that might make it hard to come

options.travel: Getting there, such as transport or distance
options.anxiety: I feel worried about the appointment
options.communication: I need information in a different format or language

barriers.errorNone: Choose at least one option, or go back if nothing is making it hard to come.
barriers.resultsTitle: Help that could make it easier

support.travel: You may be able to use community transport, or patient transport if you have a medical need. A navigator can check what is available near you.
support.cost: If you receive certain benefits or have a low income, you may be able to claim back travel costs through the Healthcare Travel Costs Scheme.
support.caring: We can look for a time that fits around school or caring. Local carers' services may also be able to help.
support.work: We can give you an appointment letter for your employer, or look for an earlier or later time.
support.health: Tell us what adjustments you need, such as step-free access, a longer appointment or a quieter place to wait.
support.anxiety: It is normal to feel worried. We can tell you what will happen at the appointment, and you can bring someone with you.
support.communication: We can send information in Welsh or English, easy read, large print, audio or British Sign Language.
support.other: Someone from our team can talk it through with you.

barriers.nextHeading: What would you like to do?

rebook.title: Change or cancel your appointment
rebook.hint: Giving your time back early means someone else waiting for care can use it.
rebook.cancelOption: I no longer need this appointment
rebook.errorNone: Choose a new time, or tell us you no longer need the appointment.
rebook.bookedBody: Your new appointment is on {date} at {time}. We will send you a reminder the day before.
rebook.cancelledBody: Thank you for letting us know. Your time can now be offered to someone else. If your symptoms change, contact your GP.

navigator.title: Ask for a phone call
navigator.intro: A community navigator from a local support organisation can call you to help with whatever is making it hard to come.
navigator.languageLegend: Which language would you like us to call you in?
navigator.timeLegend: When is a good time to call?
navigator.phoneHint: We will call the phone number we already have for you.
navigator.errorNone: Choose a language and a time for the call.
navigator.doneTitle: Thank you, we will call you
navigator.doneBody: A navigator will call you within 2 working days, in the language you chose.

landing.cardBody: Get ready for your hospital appointment.
